title: Migrate CodeMaster's backlog to JSON (source of truth) + generate ROADMAP.md
acceptance_criteria: blueprint/v1/backlog/roadmap.json + tickets/CM-<n>-<slug>/ticket.json are the canonical backlog (folder-per-ticket; README.md -> ticket.json; plan.md/evidence.md kept as files)
Every board id has a ticket (roadmap-only line-items CM-1..6 / CM-26..33 migrated as minimal stubs)
ROADMAP.md is generated by scripts/gen_roadmap.py with no content loss (only cosmetic whitespace vs the original); roadmap_stats.py still parses it
ticket.schema.json relaxed (spec/depends_on/blocks/verification optional; type enum covers task/fix/docs/ci/...) so CM tickets validate; validator extended to the repo-root blueprint/
Triggers: a .githooks/pre-commit regenerates ROADMAP.md when backlog JSON is staged; a CI rung (gen_roadmap.py --check) fails on drift
new-ticket / start-ticket / spec rewired to the JSON backlog; the 47 markdown ticket folders removed
goal: Make the JSON blueprint backlog CodeMaster's single source of truth, with ROADMAP.md generated from it — closing the last gap where the meta-repo didn't eat its own dogfood.
verification: node scripts/validate-blueprint.js (111 files, 0 violations); python3 scripts/gen_roadmap.py --check; bash scripts/ci.sh green. (Ladder: conformance + roadmap-sync rungs.)
notes: Supersedes the 2026-06-05 two-serializations decision (which kept CM markdown). Done at the user's request. ROADMAP.md must never be hand-edited now. Follow-ups: unify the greenfield examples to folder-per-ticket if desired; sweep docs/site prose that still says 'markdown backlog'.
